concept_map.chapter_overview: Aaj hum NCERT Class 9 Mathematics ke Chapter 12 — रेखाएँ और कोण — ko padhenge. Is chapter mein hum review karenge line, ray, line segment aur types of angles; phir adjacent angles, linear pair, vertically opposite angles, intersecting aur parallel lines, Linear Pair Axiom, aur Theorem: jab do lines intersect karti hain toh vertically opposite angles equal hote hain. Yeh sab baatein proofs aur numerical problems ke liye foundation hain.
concept_map.welcome: Namaste class! Smart Board par aaj Geometry ka ek bahut useful chapter shuru karte hain — रेखाएँ और कोण. Socho: school exhibition ke liye baans se jhopdi ka model banana ho, architect building ka map banaye, ya science mein light ray diagram — har jagah lines aur angles ka knowledge chahiye. Teacher aaj physically nahi hain, lekin main tumhare saath step-by-step padhaunga. Ready ho? Chalk aur compass soch ke baith jao!
learning_outcomes: रेखाखंड, किरण, रेखा, संरेख बिंदु aur कोण के प्रकार (न्यून, सम, अधिक, ऋजु, प्रतिवर्ती) ko clearly identify karna
पूरक, संपूरक, आसन्न कोण, रैखिक युग्म aur शीर्षाभिमुख कोण ki definitions apply karna
प्रतिच्छेदी aur समांतर रेखाओं ka difference aur parallel lines ke beech distance samajhna
रैखिक युग्म अभिगृहीत (6.1, 6.2) aur प्रमेय 6.1 (vertically opposite angles equal) se proofs aur numericals solve karna

generated.concept: आधारभूत पद – रेखाखंड, किरण, रेखा और संरेख बिंदु
generated.say: Ab basic terms ka पुनर्विलोकन — revision — karte hain, bilkul NCERT jaisa. रेखा का वह भाग जिसके दो अंत बिंदु हों — रेखाखंड (line segment). रेखा का वह भाग जिसका एक अंत बिंदु हो — किरण (ray). Poori रेखा dono directions mein endlessly jaati hai. Notation: generally रेखाखंड AB ko AB, uski लंबाई ko bhi AB, किरण AB ko AB, रेखा AB ko AB — book kehte hai hum alag-alag special symbols har baar nahi use karenge; अर्थ संदर्भ से स्पष्ट हो जाएगा. Kabhi-kabhi chhote letters l, m, n se bhi lines dikhayi jaati hain. Agar तीन या अधिक बिंदु एक ही रेखा पर स्थित हों, toh वे संरेख बिंदु (collinear points) कहलाते हैं; वरना असंरेख बिंदु (non-collinear points). Classroom tip: teen students ek seedhi line mein khade — collinear; agar teesra thoda aage-peeche — non-collinear. Yaad rakho — angle banane ke liye baad mein non-collinear rays chahiye. Geometry figures padhte waqt pehle identify karo: yeh segment hai, ray hai, ya full line? Segment ki length measure hoti hai; ray ki length nahi kehte usi tarah; line infinite hoti hai. Exam mein diagram mein arrows dono taraf = line; ek taraf arrow = ray; no arrows / two endpoints marked = segment. Yeh foundation saaf hogi toh aage adjacent angles aur linear pair bilkul clear lagenge. Har figure se pehle labels padho, phir type decide karo.
generated.example: Blackboard ke left corner se right corner tak chalk line — agar dono ends marked hain toh रेखाखंड; agar ek end se shuru karke endlessly extend socho toh किरण/रेखा.
board_lines: रेखाखंड: 2 endpoints | किरण: 1 endpoint | रेखा: no endpoints (both ways infinite)
Notation: AB may mean segment/ray/line/length — अर्थ संदर्भ से
संरेख बिंदु: 3+ points on same line; else असंरेख
generated.common_mistake: Students ray aur line segment ko mix kar dete hain — ray ka ek hi endpoint hota hai aur ek direction mein infinitely jaati hai; segment ke do endpoints hote hain aur limited length.
generated.memory_trick: S-R-L: Segment = Stick (do ends); Ray = Rocket (ek launch point); Line = Limitless both ways.
generated.gesture_action: Do ungliyan endpoints dikhao (segment); ek ungli se shuru karke door tak point (ray); dono haath opposite sides failao (line)
real_life_examples: Railway track ki poori line vs station A se B tak ka track piece (segment)
Torch ki light beam — bulb se ek direction mein (ray jaisa idea)

worked_example.problem: Points A, B, C ek hi seedhi line par hain; D us line par nahi hai. Kaun collinear hain? AB line segment hai ya ray — agar A aur B dono ends marked hain?
steps: Same line par A,B,C → संरेख (collinear); D → असंरेख relative to that line
Do endpoints marked A aur B → रेखाखंड AB
Ray tab hoti jab sirf ek endpoint ho aur doosri taraf extend ho
worked_example.answer: A, B, C collinear; D non-collinear with them on that line. AB with two endpoints = line segment.

generated.revision_point: Collinear = same line; notation AB context se; segment ≠ ray ≠ line.
generated.exam_tip: 1-mark definition: collinear points — ‘तीन या अधिक बिंदु एक ही रेखा पर’ exact phrase yaad rakho.
generated.source_text_hint: यदि तीन या अधिक बिंदु एक ही रेखा पर स्थित हों, तो वे संरेख बिंदु

generated.concept: कोणों के प्रकार – न्यून से प्रतिवर्ती तक
generated.say: Jab दो किरणें एक ही अंत बिंदु से प्रारम्भ होती हैं, तो एक कोण बनता है. Dono किरणें = कोण की भुजाएँ (arms/sides); common endpoint = शीर्ष (vertex). Ab types — आकृति 6.1 jaisa: (i) न्यून कोण (acute): 0° se bada aur 90° se chhota. (ii) समकोण (right angle): ठीक 90°. (iii) अधिक कोण (obtuse): 90° se bada, 180° se chhota. (iv) ऋजु कोण (straight angle): exactly 180°. (v) प्रतिवर्ती कोण (reflex): 180° se bada, 360° se chhota. Classroom mein clock socho — 3 baje ka angle roughly right; 2 baje acute; 4–5 baje obtuse jaisa lag sakta hai. Straight angle ek seedhi line jaisa dikhta hai. Reflex woh bada angle hai jo peeche mudkar bada hissa leta hai — jaise 270°. Bahut students 120° ko reflex bol dete hain — galat! 120° obtuse hai kyunki 90 se bada, 180 se chhota. Reflex tab jab 180 cross ho. Naming: ∠AOB matlab vertex O beech mein, arms OA aur OB. Board tip: hamesha vertex beech mein likho. Yeh classification aage complementary-supplementary aur linear pair samajhne se pehle crystal clear honi chahiye, kyunki linear pair mein straight angle 180° ka idea chhupa hai. Roz practice: random degrees bolo aur type identify karo — speed badhegi.
generated.example: Copy ke kone ka angle ≈ 90° (समकोण); khuli book ke pages ka angle often अधिक कोण; poori seedhi line par bana angle = ऋजु कोण 180°.
board_lines: Acute: 0° < θ < 90° | Right: θ = 90° | Obtuse: 90° < θ < 180°
Straight (ऋजु): θ = 180° | Reflex (प्रतिवर्ती): 180° < θ < 360°
Angle = two rays + common vertex; name ∠AOB (O = vertex)
generated.common_mistake: 120° ya 150° ko प्रतिवर्ती (reflex) bol dena — woh अधिक (obtuse) hote hain; reflex 180° se बड़ा होना चाहिए.
generated.memory_trick: A-R-O-S-Re: Acute-Right-Obtuse-Straight-Reflex — order chhote se bade measure tak.
generated.gesture_action: Do arms se 45° (acute), 90° (L-shape), 120° (obtuse), 180° (seedha), phir badi reflex turn dikhao
real_life_examples: Wall aur floor ka junction ≈ समकोण
Fully opened folding bed/door nearly seedhi line — ऋजु कोण jaisa

steps: 35° → between 0 and 90 → न्यून (acute)
90° → समकोण; 125° → between 90 and 180 → अधिक (obtuse)
180° → ऋजु; 270° → between 180 and 360 → प्रतिवर्ती (reflex)

easy: ऋजु कोण और समकोण का माप लिखो।
medium: क्या 180° अधिक कोण है? कारण सहित उत्तर दो।
hard: Ek angle 200° hai. Iske corresponding smaller angle (same arms) ka measure kya hoga aur dono types kaunse hain?

generated.summary: Angles: acute (<90), right (90), obtuse (90–180), straight (180), reflex (180–360) — vertex aur arms se banate hain.
generated.revision_point: Boundaries yaad rakho: 90 aur 180 pe exact names change hote hain; reflex > 180.
generated.exam_tip: Fill-in/MCQ mein inequalities strict hoti hain — acute mein 90 include mat karo; obtuse mein 180 include mat karo.
generated.source_text_hint: एक न्यून कोण का माप 0° और 90° के बीच होता है

generated.say: Ab pairs of angles. Agar दो कोणों का योग एक समकोण, yani 90°, के बराबर हो — पूरक कोण (complementary angles). Example: 30° aur 60°. Agar योग 180° हो — संपूरक कोण (supplementary angles). Example: 110° aur 70°. Complementary aur supplementary sirf measures ke sum par depend karte hain — unhe adjacent hona zaroori nahi. Ab आसन्न कोण (adjacent angles) — आकृति 6.2. दो कोण आसन्न कहलाते हैं यदि: (1) एक उभयनिष्ठ शीर्ष हो, (2) एक उभयनिष्ठ भुजा हो, aur (3) उनकी वे भुजाएँ जो उभयनिष्ठ नहीं हैं, उभयनिष्ठ भुजा के विपरीत ओर स्थित हों. Figure mein ∠AOC aur ∠COB adjacent hain — common arm OC, common vertex O; non-common arms OA aur OB opposite sides of OC. Jab do angles adjacent hote hain, unka sum us angle ke barabar hota hai jo non-common arms se banta hai: ∠AOB = ∠AOC + ∠COB. Dhyan do — ∠AOB aur ∠AOC adjacent nahi hain kyunki non-common arms OC aur OB, common arm OA ke एक ही ओर hain. Yeh ‘opposite sides’ condition bahut students miss karte hain. Board par hamesha teen cheezein tick karo: common vertex? common arm? non-common arms opposite sides? Tabhi adjacent bolo. Complementary/supplementary alag idea hai — sum check karo; adjacent figure-based idea hai — position check karo.
generated.example: Window ke corner par 40° aur 50° milakar 90° — complementary; road ke straight turn par 120° aur 60° — supplementary (measures).
board_lines: Complementary: ∠1 + ∠2 = 90° | Supplementary: ∠1 + ∠2 = 180°
Adjacent: common vertex + common arm + non-common arms on opposite sides
If adjacent: ∠AOB = ∠AOC + ∠COB
generated.common_mistake: Sirf common vertex aur ek common arm dekh kar adjacent bol dena — agar non-common arms common arm ke same side par hain toh adjacent nahi.
generated.memory_trick: C90-S180: Complement se Ninety, Supplement se Straight (180). Adjacent = ‘Aas-paas opposite sides’.
generated.gesture_action: Do students ko common shoulder (vertex) aur common stick (arm) do; non-common arms ko opposite sides failao — adjacent pose
real_life_examples: Set-square ke 30°-60° angles complementary banate hain with right angle of frame
Door frame corner: wall angle + door opening angle adjacent dikh sakte hain jab common edge shared ho

worked_example.problem: ∠AOC = 35°, ∠COB = 55°, aur yeh adjacent hain with non-common arms opposite. ∠AOB? Kya ∠AOC aur ∠COB complementary hain?
steps: Adjacent sum: ∠AOB = 35° + 55° = 90°
35° + 55° = 90° → yes, complementary also
Note: complementary hone ke liye adjacent hona zaroori nahi tha, lekin yahan dono true
worked_example.answer: ∠AOB = 90°. Haan, yeh pair complementary bhi hai.

easy: पूरक कोणों का योग कितना होता है? संपूरक का?
medium: आसन्न कोणों की तीन शर्तें लिखो।
hard: Explain with reason: kyun ∠AOB aur ∠AOC (common arm OA, non-common OB & OC same side of OA) adjacent nahi kehlaate.

generated.summary: Complementary sum 90°, supplementary 180°; adjacent need common vertex, common arm, opposite non-common arms — then big angle = sum of two.
generated.revision_point: Adjacent ≠ automatically complementary/supplementary; check the three conditions carefully.
generated.exam_tip: Definition-based 2-mark: adjacent angles — ‘विपरीत ओर’ wali condition zaroor likho, warna half marks cut.
generated.source_text_hint: दो कोण आसन्न कोण कहलाते हैं, यदि उनमें एक उभयनिष्ठ शीर्ष हो

generated.concept: रैखिक युग्म और शीर्षाभिमुख कोणों का परिचय
generated.say: Ab special pairs. Agar आकृति 6.2 mein non-common arms OA aur OB ek रेखा bana dein, toh figure आकृति 6.3 jaisa ho jaata hai — tab ∠AOC aur ∠COB कोणों का एक रैखिक युग्म (linear pair of angles) बनाते हैं. Matlab: adjacent angles jinka non-common arms ek seedhi line banayein — linear pair. Unka sum 180° hota hai — aage Linear Pair Axiom mein clearly state karenge. Ab शीर्षाभिमुख कोण (vertically opposite angles). Jab दो रेखाएँ, मान लीजिए AB aur CD, परस्पर बिंदु O पर प्रतिच्छेद करती हैं — आकृति 6.4 — tab चार कोण बनते हैं. Vertically opposite pairs opposite corners par hote hain, vertex O common. Book poochti hai: ek pair ∠AOC aur ∠BOD; क्या आप दूसरा युग्म ज्ञात कर सकते हैं? Haan — ∠AOD aur ∠BOC. Intuition: crossing scissors ke opposite openings equal dikhte hain — later Theorem 6.1 se सिद्ध करेंगे ki woh equal hote hain. Abhi sirf identify karna seekho: intersecting lines → two pairs of vertically opposite angles; side-by-side angles on a straight line → linear pairs. Board par cross banao, opposite angles same colour se mark karo — yaad reh jaayega. Naming carefully: vertex hamesha beech mein. Galat pair choose karna numericals mein sabse common slip hai, isliye pehle colour-code, phir measure.
generated.example: Letter ‘X’ banao — upar-neeche opposite angles ek pair; left-right opposite doosra pair — vertically opposite.
board_lines: Linear pair: adjacent angles whose non-common arms form a line → sum 180°
Two lines intersect at O → 4 angles; 2 pairs of vertically opposite angles
Pairs: ∠AOC & ∠BOD; ∠AOD & ∠BOC
generated.common_mistake: Adjacent angles ko hi vertically opposite bol dena — vertically opposite ‘opposite’ hote hain, side-by-side nahi.
generated.memory_trick: Linear = Line (seedhi line par pair); Vertical = ‘X’ ke opposite corners.
generated.gesture_action: Do sticks cross karke ‘X’; opposite angles par fingers point karke ‘vertically opposite’ bolo; adjacent par ‘linear pair’
real_life_examples: Scissors ya tongs kholte waqt opposite openings
Road crossing (plus junction) par opposite traffic corners ke angles

worked_example.problem: Lines AB aur CD O par intersect. Angles: ∠AOC, ∠COB, ∠BOD, ∠DOA. Vertically opposite pairs aur ek linear pair likho.
steps: Vertically opposite: ∠AOC with ∠BOD; ∠COB with ∠DOA
Linear pair example: ∠AOC aur ∠COB (arms along AB if A-O-B straight)
Similarly ∠AOC + ∠AOD = 180° if C-O-D straight
worked_example.answer: V.O. pairs: (∠AOC, ∠BOD) and (∠AOD, ∠BOC). Linear pair e.g. ∠AOC & ∠COB (on straight line AOB).

easy: रैखिक युग्म की परिभाषा एक वाक्य में लिखो।
medium: दो प्रतिच्छेदी रेखाओं से बने शीर्षाभिमुख कोणों के दोनों युग्म लिखो।
hard: Ek figure mein batao kaunse angles adjacent hain, kaunse linear pair, kaunse vertically opposite — teen columns mein classify karo.

generated.summary: Linear pair = adjacent on a straight line; vertically opposite = opposite angles when two lines cross — identify before proving equality.
generated.revision_point: X-figure: opposite = vertically opposite; side-by-side on a line = linear pair.
generated.exam_tip: Diagram questions mein pehle pairs label karo (VO / LP) — phir measure nikaalo; galat pair pick karna common error hai.
generated.source_text_hint: आप शीर्षाभिमुख कोणों को भी याद कर सकते हैं

generated.say: Section 6.3 — प्रतिच्छेदी रेखाएँ और अप्रतिच्छेदी रेखाएँ. Ek paper par do alag lines PQ aur RS khincho. Do tarike possible — आकृति 6.5: (i) प्रतिच्छेदी रेखाएँ (intersecting lines) — ek point par milti hain; (ii) अप्रतिच्छेदी अर्थात् समांतर रेखाएँ (non-intersecting / parallel lines) — kabhi nahi milti, chahe extend karo. Yaad rakho रेखा दोनों दिशाओं में अनिश्चित रूप से विस्तृत होती है. Isliye agar do lines paper ke andar nahi mil rahi, extend karke check karo — milengi toh intersecting. Parallel lines mein, unke विभिन्न बिंदुओं पर उभयनिष्ठ लम्बों की लंबाइयाँ समान रहती हैं — yahi समान लंबाई दोनों समांतर रेखाओं के बीच की दूरी कहलाती है. Matlab distance between parallels constant hoti hai — ruler se perpendicular distances equal.
